build_Gpt2Agent: build a Gpt2Agent with Hugging Face GPT-2 pretrained weights for dialogue generation
run_GPT2Decoder_forward: run the GPT2Decoder forward pass with encoder state and incremental state for token generation
init_GPT2Decoder_from_pretrained: initialize a GPT2Decoder from a pretrained Hugging Face GPT-2 model by size or name
decode_HFGPT2Model_forced: decode forced labels through the HFGPT2Model to compute logits and predictions
reorder_HFGPT2Model_decoder_state: reorder the HFGPT2Model decoder incremental state by beam search indices
